description: SMS templates optimized for 160 character limit with high engagement rates

rules: Stay under 160 characters to avoid splitting

templates.name: Direct Question
templates.body: Hi {{firstName}}! Quick Q about {{companyName}} in {{location}}. Helped similar {{industry}} biz grow 40%. Worth a quick chat? Reply YES. -{{senderName}}

templates.name: Value Proposition
templates.body: {{firstName}} - noticed {{companyName}}. We help {{industry}} in {{location}} with [benefit]. 5min call? Reply YES for my calendar. -{{senderName}}

templates.name: Curiosity Hook
templates.body: {{firstName}}, saw {{companyName}} online. Have an idea that could help. Quick call this week? Reply YES or call me. -{{senderName}} [phone]

templates.name: Local Connection
templates.body: Hi {{firstName}}! Working with {{industry}} businesses in {{location}}. Quick question about {{companyName}}. Got 2 min? Reply YES. -{{senderName}}

followup_templates.name: Gentle Follow-up
followup_templates.body: {{firstName}} - following up on my message about {{companyName}}. Still interested? Reply YES or NO so I know. Thanks! -{{senderName}}

followup_templates.name: Last Try
followup_templates.body: {{firstName}}, last message I promise! Still want to chat about {{companyName}}? Reply YES. Otherwise I'll stop bugging you. -{{senderName}}

positive_response.reply: Awesome! Here's my calendar: [short_link]. Or I can call you - what's best?

negative_response.reply: No problem! I've removed you. Won't message again. Best of luck with {{companyName}}! -{{senderName}}

timing_response.reply: Understood! When should I check back? Reply with a timeframe (e.g., '2 weeks', 'next month'). -{{senderName}}

info_request.reply: I help {{industry}} businesses with [specific value prop]. Can I send you a quick email with details? -{{senderName}}

opt_out_templates.automatic_reply: You've been removed. Won't text again. Thanks! -{{senderName}}
opt_out_templates.help_reply: This is {{senderName}} from [company]. To stop messages reply STOP. For info reply INFO.

character_optimization_tips: Use numbers instead of spelling them out
Consider emojis sparingly (they count as 1-2 chars)
